jobs.description: Overview of the role:As a member of the Enterprise Insights team at Target in India, you will expand efforts to help shape the ideal guest (consumer) experience and drive business and communication strategies and activations. This role supports the Category Insights team, which focuses on understanding consumer behaviors, attitudes, needs, and motivations across Target’s core businesses.You will play a key role in bridging the gap between business and guests through research by collaborating with multiple stakeholders including merchandisers, marketers, category managers, and creative teams. You will be responsible for designing and executing guest or consumer research to support key initiatives. You will be the primary contact for internal partners and will identify the appropriate research method, data source and vendor/supplier to execute work. Target leverages both qualitative and quantitative techniques and various secondary and proprietary sources of data to conduct research studies. As an advocate for the guest, you’ll be expected to frame findings into compelling insights and stories to establish guest understanding and empathy on the team and drive effective changes. Your work will have to include actionable recommendations for teams to then run with and achieve desired business goals for the organization.As a Sr. Marketing Researcher of Category Insights, you will report to the Sr. Manager, Insights and have responsibility for a Merchandise Pyramid.Responsibilities:Identify best method or mix of methods for the research plan, timeline and resourcing.Work closely with cross-functional teams to identify and develop research plan based on analysis of knowledge gaps, project goals and risks.Conduct consumer research and report findings.Perform thorough qualitative/quantitative analysis to create meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.Work on an iterative approach through close alignment with business teams to influence impact of the project.Skills:Ability to operate using a range of quantitative survey methods and techniques, qualitative methods/techniques, ethnographic and anthropological research, statistical testing within quantitative methods, sampling, and data analysis and synthesis across methodsSolve business problems with a consumer- centered approach.Strong grasp of quantitative data analysis and statistics from a business perspective, including generating and distilling reports from syndicated and secondary sourcesConducting field research (both quantitative and qualitative), including preparing survey design/ discussion guides etc.Strong collaboration to effectively influence a diverse set of stakeholders.Communicate complex concepts clearly and persuasively across different audiences and varying levels of the organization.Manage ambiguity, work autonomously, meet deadlines and multi-task in an agile environment.Preferred Background:Four-year degree or equivalent experienceRetail/E-Commerce ExperienceMinimum of 5 years of Consumer Insights experienceSignificant experience with different methods of quantitative, qualitative, syndicated and first-party insight toolsExperience analyzing syndicated and secondary data sources, as well as macro trend analysis

jobs.description: As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. We believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference. As an equal opportunity employer, Target provides diverse opportunities for everyone to grow and winFueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Marketing organization. Target Marketing is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.We study our guests to discover new needs and insights, and then craft every interaction to build brand love. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our guests, guest segmentsand behaviors, business objectives, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Our commitment to partnering both internally and with external agencies gives us a wide range of capabilities, from award-winning creative work to exciting and unique promotional marketing. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target.Target in India Marketing delivers differentiating yet relevant marketing communication solutions across channels operating as an integrated ONE global team and it strives to bring excellence every time in how they create, connect and collaborate.A role with Target in India Marketing is an opportunity to work with some of the best in the business for marketing, strategy & digital and you’d lead/contribute to work that connects to millions of guests. Yourinfluence will drive sales and grow brand love through work that’s guest-centric, on brand, category relevant and channel focusedAbout This OpportunityAn Art Director on the social team should have a deep understanding of the social media space. They should be able to partner with a copywriter to conceptualize and execute creatives that are optimized for the social medium – Instagram, Pinterest, Tiktok & Facebook primarily.Roles And ResponsibilitiesPossess an understanding of design for short format videos – layout, typography, colour and animation.Create contemporary digital led layouts with strong typography and animation/motion cues.Participate in brainstorm sessions and work with the team towards creative solutionsMust be able to read, write and communicate effectively in the English languageMust be familiar with American culture and vernacularRemain current with the latest style, graphic, industry and technology trends and apply this to projectsLook-up and research for a stronger understanding of different media.RequirementsMinimum 5 years at an Advertising agency, Social Agency or Design house (with digital)Experience with working on Mac OSX / iOS / Apple operating systemProficient at Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and other design tools. jobs.description: Marketing Operations Analyst – Accounts Payable - MediaAbout us:Target is an iconic brand, a Fortune 50 company and one of America’s leading retailers. Target Marketing is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our business objectives, guest segments and behaviors, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Our commitment to partnering both internally and with external agencies gives us a wide range of capabilities, from award-winning creative work to exciting and unique promotional marketing. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target.As a Marketing Operations Analyst, the primary purpose of this role is to support Marketing by ensuring accurate execution of marketing operational processes, invoicing, billing, maintaining related reports and documentation, and providing marketing system administrative oversight. This role works closely with various Marketing teams and communicates with external vendors as needed to maintain operational tasks within the assigned functional area (Marketing Technology, Data Operations, and/or Marketing Finance). This role is critical to Target in ensuring that key administrative tasks and operational processes are executed on time and without error.Responsibilities:Respond to external vendors and internal managers regarding all aspects of the accounts payable process, including processing invoices for payment.Verify the accuracy of vendor invoices and confirm that the correct general ledger account codes are used.Generate payment to vendors on a routine schedule and match the check with backup for review by the financial manager.Inspect paid and unpaid invoices including cleared payment inquiries and check voiding to maintain accurate files and records according to company standards.Review automatic payments to ensure correct coding and authorization as well as sufficient contracts and documentation.Develop and maintain a filing system for financial information, records and documents to ensure easily available information.Monitor account balances, track expenses, prepare analyses of accounts and related financial activity to produce monthly financial reports.Ensures daily execution by reviewing new requests and entering required details into the relevant marketing systems and reports.Acts as point of contact for marketing teams and external vendors for procedural and administrative support relative to the assigned marketing systems.Implements and executes measurable and sustainable process improvements that drive accuracy and workflow productivity and reduce rework.Collaborates with internal marketing teams and other relevant business areas to ensure the accurate and timely execution of marketing operational process.Researches and responds to questions from internal marketing teams and external vendors regarding related system or process issues.Supervising and supporting/training associate analyst on the team.Raises issues to direct leader for guidance and support in resolution. Performs other duties as assignedFosters a collaborative environment by being approachable and equipped with a “can-do” attitude.Occasional mentoring or leading team members.Pursues self-development, seeks feedback, adapts to and learns from change, difficulties and feedback.About You3-4 years of experience in marketing/media operations, with a focus on accounts payable and financial processes.Strong knowledge ofmedia buying, invoicing, and financial reconciliationin a marketing environment.Proficiency inaccounting software and ERP systems(e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday) is a plus.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret financial data and marketing metrics.Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities.Effective communication and collaboration skills to work across marketing, finance, and procurement teams.Advanced proficiency inExcel, Google Sheets, and financial reporting tools.Preferred Qualifications:Experience indigital marketing and media buying platforms(e.g., Google Ads, Meta, DSPs).Knowledge offinancial compliance and procurement processes.Experience working in afast-paced environment.

jobs.description: About UsAs a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel, and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.Target Creative’s Brand Design Labis the in-house creative team dedicated to bringing one of the world’s most beloved and recognizable owned brands to life. Our mission is to inspire a sense of joy, wonder and excitement, and to take our guests—and ourselves—somewhere new. We tell a compelling and cohesive brand story. Some of the brands we have built are Good & Gather, Favorite Day, Ever Spring, Hearth & Hand, Cat & Jack, Goodfellow & Co. Operating as one fully integrated team in both the U.S. and India, the team comprises the best and brightest talent to execute market-leading creative strategy, packaging design & brand building. We are proud to say that we have not just one or two, but eleven brands with sales above a billion dollars each. Our owned brands have grown by 18% YOY and contributed to USD 30 billion in sales last year.About this OpportunityAs anArt Director, you will design world-class creative, for Target’s owned brands portfolio, create Brand Identities and bring Packaging Designs to life, across multiple categories. You will explore and conceptualize design solutions in conjunction with Senior Designer to produce high-quality work. You will be a motivated designer and strategic systems thinker who can operate in ambiguity on multiple projects. You will need to demonstrate excellent graphic design and typography skills with photo art direction experience and expert knowledge of design tools. In this role, you should be highly creative and have a sharp eye for details. You will execute various projects by designing and also check the print production details. You will create presentations and present to various partners. Critical to the role is staying current with the latest style, graphic, industry, and technology trends and demonstrate application to projects. Creatively—you’ll create work that celebrates, resonates, and helps build and maintain meaningful connections with our guest. You’ll represent Target’s brand (voice and culture) to infuse the work with an unmistakable Target approach, seamlessly integrating a multicultural lens. You understand cultural trends and think strategically about how to show up for different audiences.If you’re passionate about design and eager to learn more, we’d like to meet you. We will support you along the way with onboarding, as well as personal and career development, to help you grow as a strong Art Director.Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. jobs.description: As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 5,000 team members powering the company’s global strategy and operations.Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. jobs.description: As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. We believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference. As an equal opportunity employer, Target provides diverse opportunities for everyone to grow and winTarget Creative is the in-house creative agency dedicated to bringing one of the world’s most beloved and recognizable brands to life. Whether through design, marketing or brand work, we are the driving force behind delivering Target’s dynamic, inventive and unmistakable storytelling to its massive global audience. Our mission is to inspire a sense of joy, wonder and excitement, and to take our guests—and ourselves—somewhere new. Never resting on past wins or settling for anything less than extraordinary, our origin story built us to thrive in the competitive and changing retail marketplace. We tell a compelling and cohesive brand story, maximizing our messages across multiple platforms—whether via a digital art gallery or a new $1 billion children’s clothing brand. Operating as one fully integrated team in both the U.S. and overseas, Target Creative comprises the best and brightest talent to execute market-leading creative strategy, design, writing, video production, operations, digital, UX, social media and more. We leverage smart and rewarding external partnerships while closely aligning with our Target teams. About UsAs a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel, and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.Target Creative’s Brand Design Labis the in-house creative team dedicated to bringing one of the world’s most beloved and recognizable owned brands to life. Our mission is to inspire a sense of joy, wonder and excitement, and to take our guests—and ourselves—somewhere new. We tell a compelling and cohesive brand story. Some of the brands we have built are Good & Gather, Favorite Day, Ever Spring, Hearth & Hand, Cat & Jack, Goodfellow & Co. Operating as one fully integrated team in both the U.S. and India, the team comprises the best and brightest talent to execute market-leading creative strategy, packaging design & brand building. We are proud to say that we have not just one or two, but eleven brands with sales above a billion dollars each. Our owned brands have grown by 18% YOY and contributed to USD 30 billion in sales last year.About this OpportunityAs anArt Director, you will design world-class creative, for Target’s owned brands portfolio, create Brand Identities and bring Packaging Designs to life, across multiple categories. You will explore and conceptualize design solutions in conjunction with Senior Designer to produce high-quality work. You will be a motivated designer and strategic systems thinker who can operate in ambiguity on multiple projects. You will need to demonstrate excellent graphic design and typography skills with photo art direction experience and expert knowledge of design tools. In this role, you should be highly creative and have a sharp eye for details. You will execute various projects by designing and also check the print production details. You will create presentations and present to various partners. Critical to the role is staying current with the latest style, graphic, industry, and technology trends and demonstrate application to projects. Creatively—you’ll create work that celebrates, resonates, and helps build and maintain meaningful connections with our guest. You’ll represent Target’s brand (voice and culture) to infuse the work with an unmistakable Target approach, seamlessly integrating a multicultural lens. You understand cultural trends and think strategically about how to show up for different audiences.If you’re passionate about design and eager to learn more, we’d like to meet you. We will support you along the way with onboarding, as well as personal and career development, to help you grow as a strong Art Director.Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.Roles and ResponsibilitiesHaving a developed sense of design, a strong understanding of Brand Building, Packaging Design, and Design systems. Excellent attention to detail and brand consistency. Understanding /awareness of the global culture. Keeps abreast of current design trendsCollaborate with Design teams in Target HQ to understand business requirements and translate them into design solutions that serve the needs of our guestsAbility to contribute individually and work well within a team. Assist the senior designers in creating design solutions.Excellent ability to communicate design thinking and effective presentation skillsOrganize and plan details for multiple projects and make timely and quick decisions to meet project deadlinesThe ability to see projects through from inception to production. Having strong printing & prepress knowledgeMaintains and organizes files and project materials.Personal Attributes:Highly motivated, self-driven, and able to work independently as well as follow creative directionShow passion, optimism and drive and be able to move forward in an ambiguous environmentPassionate and excited about design. Excellence in typography, color and visualStrong communication and organizational skillsThe motivation to maintain and improve design standards. The willingness to listen to feedback and use it to improveHaving a worldview & global exposureCapable of working within a fast-paced work environment and work on multiple projects at one timePreferred Experience & Educational ProfileMinimum 3 years’ design experience in a branding/design agencyDesign degree or equivalentStrong Creative Portfolio demonstrating breadth of type, design, and photo art direction, particularly in branding & packaging designEffective written and verbal communication skillsProficiency in all key creative software programs - InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, KeynoteUseful Links-Life at Target-https://india.target.com/Benefits-https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefitsCulture-https://india.target.com/life-at-target/diversity-and-inclusion#TargetBDL

**Position Purpose**The HDE Sales Manager (SM) is responsible for creating a high performing selling culture and achieve this through store connectivity, development/coaching of team, Sales Consultant staffing and delivering world class customer service. The SM will lead a team of commissioned Sales Consultants to go into the homes of Home Depot customers and successfully close the sales of HDE's product lines . The SM drives store connectivity by building and maintaining relationships with store management and associates, continually updating/training them on HDE's product offerings. The SM is also responsible for driving lead generation efforts in the stores through the sales team. The SM will manage Sales Consultants through every aspect of the employment life cycle including hiring, training/coaching, performance management, etc. The SM will lead a team of Sales Consultants to achieve sales targets for an assigned territory and will be responsible for understanding, analyzing and prioritizing business metrics (e.g., scorecards, KPI, etc). The SM is responsible for the customer experience and ensuring the sales team delivers world class customer service; this is accomplished proactively by consistently monitoring reports to ensure customer's projects are moving through the job process efficiently as well as being accountable to Voice of the Customer scores and feedback.

* 20% - Drive Store connectivity - Drive store connectivity and building relationships with store partners. Train store partners/associates on HDE products and service offerings.

**Position Purpose**A Home Depot Installation Services (HDIS) Design Consultant is responsible for selling the Company's exterior and interior product and services to customers. The Design Consultant's primary responsibility is outside sales visits to customer homes and trade shows. Although sales efforts and incidental activities may take place at a customer's home or through virtual channels, a Design Consultant will spend the majority of his or her working time traveling and away from a dedicated office environment. Design Consultants will travel to customer's homes to make sales calls, assess customer needs, make individually-tailored product recommendations , develop and negotiate customized price quotes, present warranty information and financial options that meet the customer's needs and maintain/drive profitability. The Design Consultant will also complete required sales contracts and paperwork, and take measurements using industry standard methods to ensure orders meet required installation specifications. The Design Consultant is responsible for proactively soliciting and acquiring new customers inside assigned THD stores and during industry events (such as Home Shows). * Present warranty and available financing options to customers. Prepare for appointments, commute to/from appointments and process sales-related paperwork.
* Prospecting for new customers both inside and outside of assigned THD store and participate in scheduled industry events. Proactively seek out new referrals and develop and maintain relationships with store management and associates. **Position Purpose:**

A Home Depot Installation Services (HDIS) Sales Consultant is responsible for selling the Company's exterior product and services to customers. The Sales Consultant's primary responsibility is outside sales visits to customer homes and trade shows. Although sales efforts and incidental activities may take place at a customer's home or through virtual channels, a Consultant will spend the majority of his or her working time traveling and away from a dedicated office environment. Consultants will travel to customer's homes to make sales calls, assess customer needs, make individually-tailored product recommendations , develop and negotiate customized price quotes, present warranty information and financial options that meet the customer's needs and maintain/drive profitability. The Consultant will also complete required sales contracts and paperwork, and take measurements using industry standard methods to ensure orders meet required installation specifications. The Design Consultant is responsible for proactively soliciting and acquiring new customers inside assigned THD stores and during industry events (such as Home Shows). Your primary responsibility is to help turn leads into qualified opportunities for the sales teams. This position requires heavy outbound phone calling, qualification, consultative selling skills and tight collaboration with the Enterprise Pro Team to generate new opportunities. The SDR will be expected to report on qualification and call activity and stay thoroughly informed on all products and the home improvement retail industry in general. This is not a silo position. Req141430Position PurposeThe Home Depot is redefining the future of retail to enable doers to get more done. As the 4th largest retailer and 5th largest ecommerce retailer in the US, our marketing team sits at the intersection of brands, ideas, customers, media and content for The Home Depot. We are seeking a Sr. Analyst to be a key partner on our Pro Marketing team. The Sr. Analyst will support the Audience Strategy Manager in Pro Marketing efforts that drive business objectives and marketing strategy. This role supports the Audience Strategy Manager by collaborating in work streams with cross-functional partners to implement strategic marketing campaigns that drive short- and long-term strategies that put the Customer first and align with overarching business goals. This role will have exposure to The Home Depot business - specifically of which that supports the Pro customer both in store and enterprise-wide – while growing strong working relationships and affecting change from within one of the world's leading retailers. Key Responsibilities in this role include but are not limited to marketing reporting maintenance and management, campaign execution, support strategy development and cross functional partnership and communication.Key Responsibilities10% Ongoing Optimization and Tracking - Manage on-going non-analytics business needs including reconciliation of marketing budget, MARCOM and related team processes that add business value; Role will be critical conduit to support teams and voice to optimize enterprise marketing efforts for both internal partners and external consumer60% Planning, Implementation and Execution - Provides support in the planning, implementation and execution of marketing strategies and activities in partnership with the audience strategy leaders including brand awareness campaigns, events, and partner programs to drive traffic and sales; Support cross-functional project teams to manage and execute high-value initiatives30% Research & Tools - Research, understand and build tools that help translate insights and analytics into actionable results; This role will oversee the delivery of marketing reporting from analytics team and prepare communications that demonstrate marketing campaign progress and success; Responsible for ensuring there is on-going communication that educate business owners within the organization on key insights, factbooks, campaign performance and effectiveness of enterprise effortsDirect Manager/Direct ReportsThis position typically reports to Director, Strategic ProjectsThis position has 0 direct reportsTravel RequirementsTypically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time.Physical RequirementsMost of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. Req140333Position PurposeThe Home Depot is redefining the future of retail to enable doers to get more done. As the 4th largest retailer and 7th largest ecommerce retailer in the US, our marketing team sits at the intersection of brands, ideas, customers, media and content for The Home Depot. The SM will lead a team of commissioned Sales Consultants to go into the homes of Home Depot customers and successfully close the sales of HDE's product lines . The SM drives store connectivity by building and maintaining relationships with store management and associates, continually updating/training them on HDE's product offerings. The SM is also responsible for driving lead generation efforts in the stores through the sales team. Req138090Position PurposeThe responsibility of the Director, Marketing Measurement is to develop and lead a center of excellence around media and marketing effectiveness measurement. This person will define strategic priorities and build a roadmap to advance the marketing measurement framework, measurement products and capabilities, measurement artifacts including weekly reports, monthly business reviews and quarterly business reviews. The role will oversee or directly manage measurement products like models, reports, and dashboards. This person will work closely with the Integrated Marketing organization to generate the proper reporting requirements, including custom reporting for top suppliers. This person is responsible for managing multiple teams of analysts to develop insights and actionable insights from campaign performance and organizational goals.This is a highly collaborative, client-facing position. This person will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including media planning, media operations, data science, monetization, audience, IT and product teams, to develop new measurement solutions and technologies that drive improved media performance and accountability. This position reports directly to the Director of e-Commerce Site Operations.  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Leverage understanding of web design principles, technical capabilities, consumer behavior, and operational processes to develop and drive website strategies to increase conversion, improve customer experience, and improve how the product assortment is represented.
* Manage the Assistant Site Manager. From administrative needs and training to overseeing workload, career development, and mentorship.
* Manage and prioritize workload for team of front-end developers working on various content, UX optimization, and UI projects.
* Collaborate with Technology, Creative, Marketing, Merchandising, and Development teams to execute critical site enhancements, product launches, and promotional campaigns.
* Lead implementation of new internal product management system, and manage maintenance, new features and optimization.
* End-to-end project management of seasonal product and feature launches – from strategy inception to execution.
* Fully test/QA/UAT site initiatives prior to launching to the website -- prioritizing any issues found to be fixed and subsequently validated.
* Represent brand requirements and priorities while serving as primary or secondary lead on Technology governance roadmap projects.
* Troubleshoot and/or escalate website issues and see them through to resolution.

* Build and maintain strong relationships across all channels within the brand, other WSI brands, shared services teams, and 3rd party vendors.

**Job Description**About the role  
  
The Director of Brand Marketing and PR will lead the strategic vision and execution of public relations and brand marketing initiatives for Mark and Graham, a fast-growing lifestyle brand focused on travel, accessories, and home goods. You'll drive brand partnerships, influencer collaborations, media placements, and compelling storytelling that showcase the brand's unique position in the market. This role is ideal for a creative, resourceful leader who thrives in a collaborative, scrappy environment and can wear multiple hats while building the brand's visibility and reach.  
  
What you'll be doing

* Build and cultivate high-value relationships with influencers, celebrities, and media partners; identify and negotiate partnership opportunities that align with brand positioning and drive engagement.
* Develop partnership themes and concepts, including seasonal campaigns, sweepstakes, and collaborations (approximately quarterly) with luxury travel, lifestyle, and media partners to expand brand reach and customer acquisition.
* Manage content ideation and storytelling strategy in close collaboration with the creative team and internal stakeholders, identifying the right partners and platforms to authentically communicate brand stories.
* Lead influencer outreach and talent partnerships, identifying emerging creators and established personalities who resonate with the Mark and Graham customer and can authentically showcase products in travel and lifestyle contexts.
* Coordinate with retained PR agency on media relations and earned media opportunities, serving as the primary point of contact for all PR communications and ensuring alignment with brand strategy.
* Work closely with the design and merchandising teams to understand products and market positioning, translating insights into compelling marketing and partnership angles.
* Manage daily partnership communications, negotiations, and problem resolution with external partners and stakeholders, ensuring smooth execution and satisfaction.

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* Willingness to be hands-on and adaptable in a growing organization with a startup mentality.

**Job Description**

**Overview of the Merchandise Analyst role**

The eCommerce team is responsible for delivering a superior site experience for the customer, using data and customer insights to deliver easy, inspiring product discovery and helpful, intuitive, content-rich product pages.

You will have the opportunity to collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to deliver a seamless, friction-free, shopping experience online.

**Responsibilities**

* Perform product builds and UAT (Seasonal as well as weekly checks)
* Perform regular incremental updates/maintenance of the web assortment, adhering to the standards of our US sites
* Monitoring the performance of Related Product setup and Group-to-Category setup
* Create/build out categories, thumbnails and visual navigation set up and quarterly updates
* Perform season copy/delete
* Update SEO copy when required
* Managing promotion set-up and takedown
* Resolve/fix PIP (Product Information Page) issues raised by merchants and stores
* Continual review of sites conducting PIP and site scrubs to ensure a seamless and accurate shopping experience
* Support ad-hoc projects as assigned
* Work across multiple platforms including Adobe Experience Manager, Airtable, Curalate and Constructor
* Build and maintain relationships based on thorough planning, timely and professional communications, and intelligent problem-solving with internal partners, and cross-functional resources.

**Criteria**

* Min tertiary qualification and 2 years of e-commerce or related experience (candidates with less experience can be considered for the Specialist position)
* Ability to make timely decisions, anticipate problems, and provide creative solutions
* Strong affinity for the products and brands
* Proven analytical, business planning, and organizational skills
* Ability to deal with ambiguity, fast pace, and a changing environment
* Experience working in a global business and across multiple time zones
* Strong attention to detail
* Intermediate Excel skills (working knowledge with pivot tables and v-lookups)

We believe in People First

We firmly believe that working in a culture focused on diversity, equity, and inclusion spurs innovation, creates healthy and high-performing teams, and delivers superior customer experiences. Today, we are a more than USD 8.7 billion company, with a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

The Singapore regional office was set up in 2008 and we currently have more than 160 associates in functions such as sustainability, customs & compliance, finance, human resource, information technology, inventory planning, logistics, sourcing and quality assurance.

The Global team is an inclusive employer where we recruit and provide employees with fair opportunities on the basis of merit, regardless of age, race, gender, religion, marital status and family responsibilities, or disability. Find out more about us at our WSI LinkedIn Page!

**Job Description****About the Team**The Digital Marketing team is responsible for the in-house media planning, campaign management, and performance optimization of all paid digital advertising including Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic, and Affiliate channel strategies. The team executes evergreen and initiative-based tactics to drive incremental revenue, site traffic, and new customer acquisition with a focus on using data to drive the most efficient return on ad spend. The team acts as a centralized digital advertising agency servicing all Williams-Sonoma Inc. (WSI) Brands and International sites.  
  
**About The Role**You will lead the Programmatic & Paid Social teams, driving forward media innovation while ensuring proper execution of campaigns across both channels. You will use your extensive hands-on-keys experience to develop near & long-term strategies to increase incremental revenue, site traffic, and new customer acquisition. Your focus will be on efficient operations, accurate execution, performance optimization, and data analysis to maximize the efficiency of our media investments. You will bridge the gap between internal business stakeholders and external partners, educating internal partners on best practices and leading the relationship with key vendors to ensure WSI stays at the forefront of testing & optimization.  
  
You will also be responsible for the team’s organizational design and will directly oversee the performance and career development of two managers, both of whom manage teams of media buyers. This position reports to the VP of Paid Media.  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead team in the planning, management, and execution of all Programmatic & Paid Social campaigns, including but not limited to account setup, campaign structure, development and implementation of media plans, budget/pacing management, performance reporting, and optimization
* Hold team accountable for consistent performance KPIs (ROAS, CPA, CPC) and provide guidance on optimizations and campaign troubleshooting as needed
* Closely manage the media planning process from brief to launch, ensuring each team member is delivering on schedule and supporting our Brands’ goals and initiatives with the appropriate channels, audiences, and data
* Ensure weekly performance reports are delivered to internal Marketing and Brand partners accurately and on time; lead the development of new reporting as strategies evolve
* Champion an ongoing culture of innovation, including development and execution of a test & learn roadmap based on Brand/channel priorities, owning the end-to-end process from test design/measurement strategy to multi-Brand recommendations and rollout timelines
* Lead ongoing incrementality testing and optimization in collaboration with platform account teams & in-house Measurement team; leverage data clean rooms (where available) to gain deeper insights
* Partner with Measurement team to support ongoing maintenance of multi-touch attribution (MTA) and marketing mix modeling (MMM) solutions, ensuring accuracy of data inputs/outputs
* Collaborate with Customer Analytics team on advanced analyses & ad hoc reporting needs
* Act as the technical lead for the Programmatic & Paid Social teams with respect to site tags/pixels, server to server connections, product data feeds, and integrations with reporting platforms/business intelligence tools
* Lead the relationship with DSPs, SSPs, social platforms, and creative partners to optimize performance, stay educated on new opportunities/betas, and influence product roadmaps based on WSI’s needs
* Stay ahead of the latest developments in Programmatic, Paid Social, and the broader Digital advertising industry, adjusting strategies & vetting new technologies to keep up with real-time changes and mitigate impact on our performance efforts
* Be the WSI subject matter expert in Programmatic & Paid Social industry trends and best practices; educate relevant WSI teams by sharing information & recommendations across different levels within the organization, including leading cross-functional training and presenting in executive-level meetings
* Own contract management & negotiation for vendor partners within scope, including partnering with internal stakeholders (legal, IT security, corporate accounting) and abiding by corporate-wide processes
* Own all people management activities, including setting clear and measurable goals/objectives, managing performance, coaching, giving feedback, and championing growth/development to foster associate retention
* Directly manage the work and career development of 2 managers

**Criteria**

* BS/BA or equivalent work experience
* Direct response/performance marketing and/or Retail experience preferred
* Ad tech or agency experience preferred
* 10 years minimum experience with a focus in Programmatic/Paid Social management
* Proven ability to lead & develop high performing teams
* Hands-on-keys DSP and/or social platform expertise required; experience across display, native, OLV, CTV, Meta, Pinterest, YouTube, TikTok preferred
* Advanced MS Excel skills (including vlookups, pivot tables) & a passion for data-driven marketing
* Strong technical ability with proven experience working with ad platforms, pixels, and feeds
* Confidence analyzing large data sets & using findings to make recommendations, develop, and execute strategies
* Excellent written & verbal communication skills with an ability to synthesize technical detail and differentiate communication based on level and role
* Knowledge of a site analytics tool and experience working with third party reporting platforms such as Domo or Tableau
* Well-organized, high attention to detail, deadline-oriented
* Able to work independently & enjoy working with others as part of a team
* Entrepreneurial spirit & ability to work/prioritize in a fast-paced environment
* This role requires being onsite in the San Francisco office Monday through Thursday and Friday as optional in the office

**Why join us?**Because NaughtOne don’t make furniture for your home, you probably don’t know us. But LinkedIn, Google and Adobe do – because they all have our designs in their workplaces.  
  
The NaughtOne team are just as unique as the furniture we create and if you come to work with us, you’ll be joining a global business with a Yorkshire spirit. We have colleagues all over the world because the world is our customer, but our personality reflects our home: down-to-earth, friendly and honest.  
  
We’ve received numerous accolades, including The Queens Award for Enterprise for International Trade, and that makes us proud. We’ve always cared deeply about sustainability and we’re always looking for ways to do more and have a stronger impact. We don’t do it because it’s good for business – we do it because it’s the right thing.  
  
If any of that makes you curious, good – because curious people thrive at NaughtOne. Perhaps you’ll be thriving at NaughtOne soon.  
  
**Sales Support Specialist International (UK Based)**Purpose  
  
The Sales Support role is a pivotal part of the NaughtOne International Sales Team, directly supporting our sales representative across Europe, Middle-East, Asia and Africa. This position focuses on delivering an exceptional client experience throughout the sales process by providing accurate, timely, and tailored support.  
  
You will serve as the critical link between clients, sales teams, and internal operations—ensuring that all quotations, product information, and project documentation align with client expectations and brand standards. Beyond administrative duties, you’ll play an active role in supporting regional sales growth, responding proactively to opportunities, streamlining communications, and helping to resolve project-related issues during the active selling phase.  
  
This role requires a service-oriented mindset, commercial awareness, and a keen attention to detail to uphold our commitment to client satisfaction, timely project delivery, and continued market growth.  
  
Responsibilities / Key Deliverables  
  

* Respond to client enquiries and generate priced proposal documents
* Support bids & tender submissions
* Create quotations quickly and efficiently ensuring overall accuracy
* Review client specifications, co-ordinate proposal efforts with sales team members to develop an accurate and complete solution offering which meets the client's specifications.
* Participating in customer discussions as required to provide sales support and developing an understanding of expectations in order to meet and exceed requirements to maximise the customer experience
* Provide excellent customer service as the frontline contact with our clients and provide administrative support to the sales team, enabling the team to maximise sales and improve the customer experience.
* Answering and dealing as appropriate with general sales, sales leads and queries

**Qualifications, Skills, And Experience**

* Post-secondary education preferred (A-levels, associate degree, or equivalent); strong foundational skills in English and Mathematics essential
* Proven experience in a client-facing customer service or sales support role, preferably within a design-led, B2B environment
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across internal teams and external partners
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with clients, understanding their needs and delivering thoughtful, responsive support
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail, with the ability to interpret and communicate technical information clearly
* Proactive problem-solver with a calm, solution-focused approach to client queries and project challenges
* Technologically competent, with strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office; experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV or a similar ERP/CRM system highly desirable
* Comfortable navigating complex processes and systems with a mindset for continuous improvement
* Exceptionally organised with the ability to prioritise workload, manage multiple requests, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Empathetic and client-centric approach; committed to delivering a positive and professional experience throughout every stage of the sales process
* Self-motivated and dependable, with a strong sense of accountability and initiative

Dimension of role  
  
Based from the NaughtOne head office in Harrogate this is a permanent position reporting to the Senior Customer Experience Specialist (International). As part of a wider team of 9, the role holder will be expected to collaborate closely with the Operations function as well as the NaughtOne Sales teams.  
  
We support hybrid working. Company culture, relationships and collaboration are really important to us, so we’ll encourage you to spend the majority of your time on site.  
  
**Who We Hire?**At NaughtOne we believe in keeping things simple. So simply put, we hire qualified applicants representing a wide range of backgrounds and abilities – we are committed to equal opportunity employment. We honour and celebrate people's individuality, diversity and authenticity. In this inclusive environment, we thrive together, creating endless opportunities for us all to shine. Here, you can bring your whole self to work.  
  
MillerKnoll complies with applicable disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact MillerKnoll Talent Acquisition at careers\_help@millerknoll.com.

**Do you want to work in an international, design-driven organization with a strong global presence and the opportunity to shape long-term growth in the Nordic market? MillerKnoll is now strengthening its Nordic commercial organization and is looking for a Sales Manager responsible for the Nordic region.**

MillerKnoll is a global collective of design-led brands, formed through the merger of Herman Miller and Knoll. The organization operates across commercial and residential markets and brings together some of the world’s most influential brands within furniture and interior design.

**About the Role**

As Sales Manager – Nordic Region, you will have overall responsibility for driving sales performance across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland and Iceland. The role focuses on building strong, commercially driven relationships with designated dealers while actively developing new business opportunities with architects, designers, project management companies and end customers.

You manage the full sales cycle from lead generation to order placement and act as the primary commercial contact for assigned dealers. The role involves coordinating internal MillerKnoll resources, supporting projects throughout the sales process and ensuring high quality delivery in all customer and dealer interactions.

The position is fully remote and reports to the Head of Sales for the Nordics, Central & Eastern Europe. The role includes approximately 50% travel across the Nordic region as well as to selected European showrooms in Paris, London and Milan.

**Key Responsibilities:**

You will be responsible for developing and maintaining long-term, mutually beneficial relationships with designated dealers and ensuring MillerKnoll is positioned as the preferred partner at all levels. A key part of the role is identifying, creating and owning sales opportunities within the territory, including responsibility for product applications, specifications, mock-ups and project solutions.

You collaborate closely with internal stakeholders such as National Account Managers, Global Enterprise Accounts, Major Projects teams, Architecture & Design, and Channel Development, contributing to both regional and global opportunities. You also provide technical and specification support to dealers in cooperation with portfolio and technical teams.

The role requires accurate forecasting, structured CRM usage and timely reporting, primarily through Salesforce. You represent MillerKnoll at regional events and fairs and are expected to deliver best-in-class presentations, proposals and tender responses, both verbally and in writing.

**Is This You?**

To succeed in this role, you have a minimum of five years’ experience in B2B sales, preferably within a complex or international organization. Experience from furniture, design or architectural products, as well as dealer-based sales models, is considered an advantage. Experience working with Salesforce or similar CRM systems is beneficial. Fluency in English is required. One or more Nordic languages (Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish or Icelandic) is considered a merit. A driver’s license and willingness to travel are required.

We place great emphasis on personal attributes. You are driven, methodical and energetic, with strong interpersonal and communication skills. You act with integrity, handle objections professionally and are able to balance autonomy with collaboration in an international team environment. You are comfortable working independently in a remote setup and managing a geographically broad territory. You have a structured way of working, strong commercial understanding and the ability to build trust-based relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.

**What We Offer**

At MillerKnoll, you will be part of a global, design-led organization with a strong heritage and an international presence. The company brings together some of the world’s most influential brands within furniture and interior design, operating across both commercial and residential markets.

You will join a collaborative and values-driven organization with a flat structure and accessible leadership. The role offers a high degree of autonomy and trust, combined with close collaboration with colleagues, dealers and internal stakeholders across the Nordic region and Europe. MillerKnoll provides a stable global platform while offering the opportunity to actively contribute to the continued development and growth of the Nordic market.

**Want to Know More?**

In this recruitment, MillerKnoll is collaborating with Level Recruitment. Please apply for the position by clicking the "Apply" button here. For questions, please contact recruitment consultant Dennis Pater at +46 73 558 89 34. Kindly note that no applications will be accepted via email.

Selection of applications will take place continuously.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About MillerKnoll**

MillerKnoll is a global collective of design-led brands formed through the merger of Herman Miller and Knoll, operating as a unified organization with a broad international footprint and a multi-brand structure that includes well-known names such as Herman Miller, Knoll, HAY, Geiger, Maharam and Design Within Reach.

The company functions as a large, integrated corporate group with operations across North America, Europe, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific, serving both commercial and residential markets.

In this role, you’ll connect the dots between marketing, sales, and partner data—laying the groundwork for more precise targeting, smarter campaigns, and measurable pipeline impact. Working closely with Sales, Ecommerce, Integrated and Content Marketing, and strategic partners, you will translate customer analytics into actionable campaigns, streamline marketing processes, and advance the systems needed to generate and track qualified opportunities for our contract sales organization.

* Advance and scale integrated demand generation programs that engage prospects across the customer journey.
* Strengthen processes that align Salesforce, partner databases, and customer data to inform go-to-market strategies.
* Partner with Sales leadership to optimize lead routing, follow-up cadences, and reporting.
* Collaborate with strategic partners to incorporate customer analytics into campaign targeting and account prioritization.

**Demand Generation Execution**

* Direct integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, email, and targeted ABM initiatives.
* Lead development and execution of our ABM playbook—from strategy through activation and reporting.
* Drive performance across LinkedIn Ads and other digital channels—optimizing for cost efficiency, engagement, and pipeline impact.

jobs.description:
Rooms To Go is looking for a Digital Graphic Designer to join our growing in-house Creative Team!  
  
As a **Digital** **Graphic Designer** working within the Digital Creative Team, you will be focused on creating graphic assets and layouts for a wide mix of multimedia projects.  
  
As part of our team of digital graphic designers, you will collaborate with all of our Marketing teams - including CRM, Content, Copy, eCommerce, Merchandising and UX/UI Development.  
  
We want someone who has a keen eye for layout, cares about esthetics & typography, and gets excited about designing something new & compelling.  
  
The ideal candidate should have multiple years' experience working with and designing/thinking in the digital space. Retail experience is obviously a plus.  
  
This candidate should have experience designing digital assets, such as web-related graphics & layouts, with a focus on mobile first and responsive design. As well as a comprehensive knowledge in the general digital creative space, with an understanding of various online marketing platforms, and experience with commonly used design tools (i.e. Adobe Suite & Figma).  
  
We want someone who is curious about what is possible with design, motion and tech. With a direct emphasis on using AI to push the boundaries and exploring what comes next.  
  
As a team contributor, we expect you to multi-task while managing multiple timelines, perform tasks effectively, develop collaborative relationships cross-functionally, and display clear communication skills while being proactive & professional.  
  
In addition, the candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own creative requests such as website initiatives, branding, website landing pages, emails, Iconography, brand development.
* Conduct competitive research, including design insights and trends.
* Participate in creative briefing, testing, and brainstorming.
* Execute daily/weekly creative requests.
* Create and maintain style guides, brand guidelines, and other design documents
* Research and stay up to date on design trends and technologies.
* Develop and implement strategies for improving design processes and workflow.

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor's degree required. Marketing/Design Major preferred.
* 1-3 years relevant work (and internship) experience.
* Proficient in Adobe Creative Suites: Photoshop and Illustrator.
* Experience with Figma.
* Motion animation and/or video editing skills is a plus.

**Core Capabilities**

* Retail and/or eCommerce experience preferred.
* Creative mindset with high attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Must be a team player with a strong work ethic. Works well with others.
* Flexible under time requirements and changing deadlines.
* Strong commitment to prioritization of timelines, accuracy, organization, and professionalism.
* Dedicated commitment to deliver on all project deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and accomplish tasks with minimal oversight.
* NOTE: This role is onsite 5 days a week, in our Brookhaven office.

**About Us**Founded in 1991, Rooms To Go is one of the largest and fastest growing furniture retailers in the US with over 250 stores in ten southern states, eight distribution centers and an e-commerce business. Rooms To Go offers a collaborative work environment within a supportive culture.  
  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Associate discounts including furniture
* Company paid life and disability insurance
* Paid time off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Programs
* And more!

Rooms To Go is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or employment against any individual on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ancestry, religion, physical or mental disability, age, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, pregnancy, citizenship, or any other factor protected by anti-discrimination laws.

**Studio Art Director**The Studio Art Director is entrusted with delivering visually compelling and brand-enhancing photography and video content in collaboration with the Creative Director, overseeing projects from concept to completion. This role also encompasses maintaining established photography standards, supporting the production manager, and coordinating with the QC/post-production team to ensure effective asset management while upholding consistent, high-quality visual standards and specifications.  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Pre-Production Planning: Produce mood boards/inspiration as needed to guide the on-set team based on creative direction and strategy provided by Senior Leadership. Works with other creative team members, across multiple mediums, in the conceptualization process, beginning with the implementation stage and following through the delivery of the final product. Helping to build out model shot lists for photographers, describing actions and props. Provide room stylist insight into model wardrobe selection, while also directing Hair/Make-Up Artists on desired looks.
* On-Set Art Direction: Ensuring all photography (model/non-model) for stills and video meets brand standards by providing feedback and approving all images captured daily for Advertising Department.
* Post-Production Direction: Partner with QC/ Post-Production Team to ensure image handoffs are consistently meeting deadlines. Provides feedback to the QC/Post-Production Manager and approves final imagery prior to final upload to the DAM. Audits all image usage and ensures quality standards are being met. Gives feedback and direction to creative team members as needed.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in an Art Director or related role.
* Experience working in the home fashion industry is preferred.
* Open communication, values keeping others informed, and ability to positively inspire teams to the highest levels of quality and performance.
* Complete fluency in Adobe InDesign, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, MS Office Suite.
* Flexible and able to work with tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule based on need.
* Detail-oriented team player.
* On site; non-hybrid position.

The Studio Art Director is entrusted with delivering visually compelling and brand-enhancing photography and video content in collaboration with the Creative Director, overseeing projects from concept to completion. This role also encompasses maintaining established photography standards, supporting the production manager, and coordinating with the QC/post-production team to ensure effective asset management while upholding consistent, high-quality visual standards and specifications.

**Essential Functions:**

• Pre-Production Planning: Produce mood boards/inspiration as needed to guide the on-set team based on creative direction and strategy provided by Senior Leadership. Works with other creative team members, across multiple mediums, in the conceptualization process, beginning with the implementation stage and following through the delivery of the final product. Helping to build out model shot lists for photographers, describing actions and props. Provide room stylist insight into model wardrobe selection, while also directing Hair/Make-Up Artists on desired looks.

• On-Set Art Direction: Ensuring all photography (model/non-model) for stills and video meets brand standards by providing feedback and approving all images captured daily for Advertising Department.

• Post-Production Direction: Partner with QC/ Post-Production Team to ensure image handoffs are consistently meeting deadlines. Provides feedback to the QC/Post-Production Manager and approves final imagery prior to final upload to the DAM. Audits all image usage and ensures quality standards are being met. Gives feedback and direction to creative team members as needed.

**Qualifications:**

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field.

• 7+ years of experience in an Art Director or related role.

• Experience working in the home fashion industry is preferred.

• Open communication, values keeping others informed, and ability to positively inspire teams to the highest levels of quality and performance.

• Complete fluency in Adobe InDesign, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, MS Office Suite.

• Flexible and able to work with tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to work a flexible schedule based on need.

• On site; non-hybrid position.

jobs.description:
**Overview**Are you driven by the desire to serve customers and passionate about the art of selling? Do you excel in a dynamic retail environment, utilizing your inherent curiosity and intuition to assist customers in finding tailored solutions that transform their homes into spaces they love? If so, discover a career designed to be different!  
  
At Room & Board , our part time **Design/Retail Sales Associate** role (3 days a week, 8-hour shifts including weekends) offers an amazing way to balance your current life’s work with a fulfilling part time career. Offering you generous benefits, including health benefits, three weeks of paid vacation, 401(k), profit sharing, and more. You'll join a team of talented and professional colleagues while being surrounded by beautiful home furnishings that showcase American craftsmanship. As a valued member of our collaborative design team, you will leverage technology, tools, and resources innovatively, creating a rich and engaging experience to help customers craft homes and spaces they love.  
  
**Job location:**10071 Skookie Blvd.  
  
Skokie, IL 60077  
  
**Store Hours**Monday – Friday: 11 a.m. – 7 p.m.  
  
Saturday: 10 a.m. - 6 p.m.  
  
Sunday: 11 a.m. – 6 p.m.  
  
**Schedule**You will work a set schedule of Thursdays, Saturdays, and Sundays.  
  
You’ll enjoy one weekend off every 4 weeks. The week in which you have the weekend off, your (2) weekend shifts will be scheduled during the weekday you are typically off, so flexibility with your schedule is necessary. To allow you to easily balance your other life priorities, we build out schedules for an entire month and release them a few weeks prior to the start of each month.  
  
**What you bring to be successful as a Design / Retail Sales Associate:**

* Motivation to serve the customer with an individualized and consultative approach, understanding their needs while maintaining professionalism and respect in your interactions.
* Confidence as a team player, with self-awareness and an ability to build successful relationships with an open-mind and open-heart.
* Focus on providing the right solution in a collaborative, non-commissioned selling environment as you guide customers through the creative design process.
* Confidence in navigating and leveraging technology/tools such as the iPad, floor planning software, and POS system to enhance the customer experience.
* Energized by the high pace customer traffic and the range of interactions throughout your shift. You bring the stamina – both physical and mental – to navigate both the busy pace of customer interactions and the productivity of your down time.
* Lifelong learner mindset, continuously seeking opportunities to build knowledge and hone your craft.

**Additional position requirements and qualifications as a Design / Retail Sales Associate:**

* 2+ years of experience working in a customer-centric, fashion/design savvy retail environment with a passion for design and engaging with customers on the showroom floor.
* You bring exceptional communication skills, demonstrated confidence, attention to detail, prioritization and organization skills, and a high level of comfort navigating technology and virtual resources. These a ttributes for success captured in our Design Associate Profile .
* Ability to provide proof of identity and legal work authorization upon hire.

**What you’ll find as Design / Retail Sales Associate:**

* Salary: $31,500 - $36,000 ($25.24 - 28.85 / hour) depending on experience.
* Benefits that focus on holistic well-being. The whole person matters, not just the one who shows up for work. That’s why we invest in holistic well-being that supports and encourages you to live a full life. Besides a competitive paycheck, we offer several awesome perks to help you thrive in every aspect of life. Picture this: three weeks of paid vacation, a generous 401(k) match, profit-sharing, and a whole bunch of cool extras. We're talking about benefits that cover you from head to toe – physically, emotionally, and financially.
* Meaningful work. We create a meaningful work experience by empowering everyone to contribute, taking pride in everything we do, and making the world sustainable, inclusive and beautiful.
* A culture of respect. We sustain a culture of respect by relying on our shared values, building supportive and kind teams, and ensuring all voices are heard and celebrated

To view our benefits in detail and to learn more about our culture, please visit our career site at https://www.roomandboard.com/careers  
  
Application Deadline : The position will remain open until filled; there is no specified deadline.  
  
Room & Board is a modern furniture and home decor retailer committed to creating beautiful, well-made products while providing exceptional customer service. Our mission is to help people create homes they love through timeless designs, sustainable practices, and a focus on quality craftsmanship. To view our benefits in detail and to learn more about our culture, please visit our career site at https://www.roomandboard.com/careers.  
  
Room & Board is an equal employment opportunity employer. Our policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or staff member on the basis of age, race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, disability, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. We also prohibit harassment of applicants and staff members based on any protected category, characteristic or status. It is also our policy to comply with all applicable state, federal and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.  
  
As an applicant, you have rights under Federal Employment Laws, and your state may offer additional protections. To view applicable laws, visit our partner site .

**Overview**At Room & Board , we believe in building a better way to work and live. Rooted in principles of modern design, sustainability, and an unwavering dedication to quality, we approach our work with integrity and purpose.  
  
As a **Digital Marketing Strategist**, you will play a key role in supporting Room & Board's digital strategy of increasing brand awareness, driving campaign performance, and fueling new customer growth through our online marketing ecosystem. Reporting to the Director of Digital Marketing, you will assist in executing in-house digital channels and will work closely with external partners to provide support and guidance for externally managed digital channels. You will use data analysis and reporting to guide recommendations to drive new customers and sales through our multi-channel digital marketing campaigns — all while contributing to a team culture that's welcoming and passionate about the work we do.  
  
This is a hands-on, technical role requiring proficiency in manipulating large data sets, detailed performance analysis, and the ability to communicate complex insights to diverse stakeholders, many of whom are not digital experts. The role is not project-driven but focused on managing ongoing campaign execution, reporting, and optimization across multiple platforms.  
  
**Location:**  4600 Olson Memorial Highway, Golden Valley, MN 55422  
  
Please note: This role is hybrid with 3 days in the office. We are not currently considering remote applicants for this position.  
  
**You will share your talents as a Digital Marketing Strategist in the following ways:**

* Execute and optimize paid Pinterest campaigns to meet KPIs and align with business objectives.
* Explore and grow campaigns on LinkedIn, Reddit, and other emerging platforms to expand reach across residential and commercial audiences.
* Manage day-to-day communication and collaboration with external agency partners, ensuring campaigns consistently reflect Room & Board’s brand standards and values.
* Collaborate with Marketing Insights and Business Intelligence teams to measure performance and enhance data visibility.
* Manipulate and interpret large, complex data sets in Excel to pull out trends and actionable, business-driven insights.
* Partner with creative, content, and user experience teams to inform content strategy and creative development using data-backed insights.
* Prepare and deliver monthly performance reports to the brand team and assist in quarterly presentations to senior leadership, facilitating cross-functional alignment.
* Stay ahead of evolving digital trends, platforms, and tools—proactively recommending new tactics and innovations to enhance our marketing ecosystem.
* Assist with broader campaign planning and post-campaign evaluations in partnership with the Campaign Coordinator and Director of Digital Marketing.

**You will bring the following experiences & qualifications as a Digital Marketing Strategist:**

* 3+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience across multiple platforms, including Paid Search/Shopping, Pinterest, Meta, and Programmatic Display.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field.
* Strong technical skills with demonstrated ability to manipulate and analyze large data sets (especially in Excel).
* Proficiency with digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or Power BI.
* Experience managing or supporting Pinterest Ads Manager is a strong plus, but not required.
* Comfort and conceptual understanding of platforms you may not have executed on directly (e.g., LinkedIn, Reddit, Pinterest, Meta).
* E-commerce marketing experience preferred, but B2B experience will also be considered.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a self-directed and agile approach.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex, technical concepts for non-expert stakeholders.
* High attention to detail, especially in quality assurance, to ensure ads and content align with brand standards.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, balancing multiple priorities and deadlines.

**What you'll find working here as a Digital Marketing Strategist:**

* Salary: $70,000 - $80,000 / yr.
* Benefits that focus on holistic well-being. The whole person matters, not just the one who shows up for work. That's why we invest in holistic well-being that supports and encourages you to live a full life. Besides a competitive paycheck, we offer several awesome perks to help you thrive in every aspect of life. Picture this: three weeks of paid vacation, a generous 401(k) match, profit-sharing, and a whole bunch of cool extras. We're talking about benefits that cover you from head to toe - physically, emotionally, and financially.
* Meaningful work. We create meaningful work experience by empowering everyone to contribute, taking pride in everything we do, and making the world sustainable, inclusive, and beautiful.
* A culture of respect. We sustain a culture of respect by relying on our shared values, building supportive and kind teams, and ensuring all voices are heard and celebrated.

To view our benefits in detail and to learn more about our culture, please visit our career site at https://www.roomandboard.com/careers .
