Req #105

Bassett Furniture Corporate Office, 3525 Fairystone Prk Hwy, Bassett, Virginia, United States of America

Job Description

Posted Wednesday, October 1, 2025, 11:00 PM

**Digital Marketing & Content Manager**

**Position Overview**

The Digital Marketing & Content Manager will plan, assist with creation and oversee digital content to align with marketing goals. This role is responsible for analyzing performance of content/campaigns across social media channels. This includes maintaining content calendars and sharing information across internal and external teams. There will be a strong focus on preparing and leading the social media strategy to drive engagement and brand awareness. They will communicate events and assets to digital partners, licensed and open market partners.

The manager will collaborate with the marketing team and other departments to develop online strategies that increase company brand awareness. They will make sure that all company communications have consistent messages across social and digital channels.

They will help identify processes, techniques, and opportunities for improvement of communication of assets and events. This person will work closely with the marketing team, sales team, licensed and open market teams and outside agencies. They should be able to work collaboratively and effectively across the team while focusing on action and learning. They also will measure how effective communications strategies are and suggest improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and lead a comprehensive content strategy that supports the business and marketing objectives
* Collaborate with copywriters, graphic designers and the marketing team to produce high-quality, on-brand content
* Create and manage content calendars, including scheduling and publishing organic posts
* Support content creation, including video/reels, interactive formats, and other digital assets
* Track, analyze, and report on content performance, providing insights and recommendations
* Manage influencer partnerships and evaluate ROI
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor activity, and consumer behavior

**Skills & Competencies**

* Expertise in social media strategy, execution, and performance analysis
* Proficiency in content formats including video, reels, interactive forms/features, and GIFs
* Strong project management skills with ability to lead cross-functional collaboration
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* High attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and a self-motivated approach

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or related field
* 5-7 years of experience in digital marketing and social platform management
* Proven expertise with Meta, Pinterest, and TikTok, including content publishing and performance tracking
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* Hybrid work arrangement: partial remote flexibility with required in-office days at corporate HQ in Bassett, VA

*IND1 #LI-KS1 #ZR*

jobs.description:
**The ideal candidate would be located in Sacramento, California area and support this market.**

The Market Sales Manager has responsibility for a specific geographic territory, focused on Distribution Partners, A&D firms, and end users resulting in the achievement of profitable quota attainment. This position reports to the Regional Sales Director.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage the territory through developing, implementing and managing business strategies that align with the company's sales programs and strategies.
* Develop, manage, and review territory business plans that will result in the meeting and exceeding of the territory sales quota.
* Effectively develop, manage, and evaluate territory distribution grid on an on-going basis.
* Develop and communicate plans to support company target markets (including vertical markets).
* Understand day-to-day business as well as project business while developing strategies to grow.
* Build and maintain relationships with appropriate customers including distribution partners, A&D community as well as end users to support the territory sales goals.
* Gain proficient knowledge and use of all business support materials (i.e. all available reports surrounding dealers, dealer sales reps, products, vertical markets, etc) as well as other technical support products critical to tracking and forecasting sales and developing sales tactics and strategies to address opportunities.
* Learn and apply knowledge of company products and marketing programs throughout daily business practice.
* Train and motivate dealer salespeople and management.
* Learn and apply sales negotiation and business planning knowledge throughout daily operations to support a business consulting role to customers within the marketplace.
* Exercise initiative and creativity in the selling and marketing of Workplace ancillary products and programs.
* Work to promote a cohesive relationship with team members and internal support staff.
* Proven history or ability to demonstrate safe / responsible behavior, and a positive performance record (including attendance)
* Maintain SalesForce(CRM) for accurate forecasting
* Leverage the Los Angeles showroom with an expected weekly schedule, flexible to increase based on market demand

**Skills to Perform This Role:**

***Interpersonal Skills***

* Support team interaction
* Energetic, self-starter
* Strive for personal excellence with individual contribution to team results
* Passionate, dedicated, reliable, insightful & genuine

**Job Description****WHO WE ARE:**Saks Global is the largest multi-brand luxury retailer in the world, comprising Saks Fifth Avenue, Neiman Marcus, Bergdorf Goodman, Saks OFF 5TH, Last Call and Horchow. Its retail portfolio includes 70 full-line luxury locations, additional off-price locations and five distinct e-commerce experiences. With talented colleagues focused on delivering on our strategic vision, The Art of You, Saks Global is redefining luxury shopping by offering each customer a personalized experience that is unmistakably their own. By leveraging the most comprehensive luxury customer data platform in North America, cutting-edge technology, and strong partnerships with the world's most esteemed brands, Saks Global is shaping the future of luxury retail.  
  
Saks Global Properties & Investments includes Saks Fifth Avenue and Neiman Marcus flagship properties and represents nearly 13 million square feet of prime U.S. real estate holdings and investments in luxury markets.  
  
**You Will Be**As a Support Analyst, Digital Technical Operations , you will be responsible for troubleshooting and resolving issues related to the item lifecycle, leveraging internal tools and data analysis to identify root causes. You'll manage and track Jira tickets to ensure timely resolution within SLAs, collaborate with cross-functional teams across geographies, and generate digital operational reports for full item lifecycle.  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Troubleshoot and provide support to user reported issues related to item lifecycle, reviewing and validating reported issues for clarity and completeness
* Accurately document issues, all interactions and solutions in Jira ticketing system
* Provide guidance to users on basic system behaviors and processes related to item lifecycle
* Escalate complex problems or unresolved issues to Digital Technical Ops team in US for further action
* Ensure timely responses and ticket resolution within SLAs
* Support process and delivery of regular operational reports for all banners
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of the Digital Lifecycle & Operations knowledge base by documenting troubleshooting steps and procedures
* Support Digital Technical Ops projects and enhancements, including planning, testing, and implementation of new capabilities

**Relevant Skills**

* 2–4 years of experience in a technical support, operations, or a data analyst role
* Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Naturally curious, with strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to perform detailed root cause analysis to identify and resolve issues efficiently
* Hands-on experience with issue tracking and data realization tools; familiarity with Jira, Looker, and Tableau is a strong advantage
* Ability to write and understand SQL queries for data extraction and analysis is an added advantage
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel
* Strong and effective communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**What You Will Bring**

* Demonstrate strong analytical skills to investigate and resolve issues within the item set- up lifecycle, utilizing internal tools to identify root causes and recommend effective solutions
* Maintain a methodical and organized approach to managing Jira tickets, ensuring each issue is clearly documented with relevant context, diagnostics, and resolution steps. Track progress diligently to ensure SLA compliance and timely closure
* Utilize advanced Excel capabilities to generate accurate and timely reports across retail banners. Ensure consistency, data integrity, and compliance in all reporting deliverables
* Work closely with teams across Digital Operations and TechOps, often spanning multiple geographies and time zones. Communicate effectively to gather inputs, share updates, and drive issue resolution
* Continuously identify opportunities to streamline workflows, optimize data extraction and analysis processes, and reduce manual effort. Propose improvements and collaborate with stakeholders to implement smarter, more efficient solutions
* Translate your understanding of lifecycle processes into structured documentation and resource materials

**Your Life And Career At Saks Global**

* Opportunity to work in a dynamic fast paced environment at a company experiencing growth and transformation
* Exposure to rewarding career advancement opportunities across the largest multi-brand luxury retailer from retail to distribution, to digital or corporate
* Comprehensive benefits package for all eligible full-time employees (including medical, vision and dental)

Saks.com is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

* Manage social selling efforts including Instagram content scheduling, link tracking, click performance, and conversion insights.
* Develop and optimize outreach tools that elevate client engagement.

* Oversee retail operations including returns, order tracking, alterations, and POS management.
* Manage order fulfillment workflows, from placing orders to delivery and vendor coordination.
* Own scheduling, calendar management, and logistics for digital styling appointments.

* Work closely with Styling Assistant counterpart and Operational Assistant to ensure seamless support for the top-selling stylist.

Notre héritage repose sur la couleur, l'artisanat et une profonde **passion pour l'innovation, façonnés autant par nos produits emblématiques que par les personnes** qui leur donnent vie. Nous ne créons pas seulement des ustensiles de cuisine, nous créons des moments qui durent toute une vie. Si vous êtes inspiré par l'héritage, motivé par la créativité et prêt à façonner l'avenir de la cuisine, nous serions ravis de vous accueillir dans notre histoire.  
  
**La Recette Du Succès****Vous développez et implémentez la stratégie Marketing de la marque sur le marché Français, en ligne avec les directives nationales et globales du Groupe.**Grâce à votre réseau, vous développez l’image de la marque, renforcez sa notoriété et augmentez sa désirabilité. jobs.description:
**About Le Creuset**

At Le Creuset, every dish begins with a story - and every story begins with people.

Since 1925, we’ve brought generations together around the table, transforming everyday meals into cherished memories. Our legacy is built on colour, craft, and a deep passion for innovation - shaped as much by our iconic products as by the people who bring them to life. We’re not just creating cookware; we’re creating moments that last a lifetime. If you’re inspired by heritage, driven by creativity, and ready to shape the future of the kitchen, we’d love to welcome you into our story.

**The Recipe for Success:**

The Senior Digital Marketing Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing the digital marketing strategies of the company. The main purpose of this role is to drive brand awareness, generate leads, and increase customer engagement and conversion through various online marketing channels.

The Senior Digital Marketing Manager will need to be highly proficient in various digital marketing channels such as social media marketing, email marketing, display advertising and search engine marketing. You will be expected to continuously monitor, measure, and analyse the performance of these campaigns using tools like Google Analytics, and make data-driven recommendations for improvements.

Staying updated with industry trends and best practices will be vital, as you will need to proactively recommend new digital marketing strategies or emerging technologies to stay ahead of the competition.

As the Senior Digital Marketing Manager, you will have a budget to manage, and it will be your responsibility to allocate it effectively to maximize return on investment.

The role is based at our Cape Town Head Office in Somerset West.

**What’s on your Daily Menu?**

***Digital, strategy and performance:***

* Develop commercially-driven digital marketing strategies in collaboration with the Marketing Director and Commercial Marketing Manager to support company sales objectives.
* Lead the execution of omni-channel marketing campaigns, ensuring seamless campaign integration and messaging across platforms.
* Manage and optimise relationship with digital performance agency, including briefing, pushing for innovation, and reporting on campaign results to the business.
* Oversee user journey mapping and tool integration of the website, while also managing workflow alignment between the e-commerce and digital marketing teams to enhance the online customer experience.
* Drive SEO and SEM initiatives to maximize organic visibility and deliver effective performance marketing outcomes.
* Monitor, measure, and analyse campaign performance, providing actionable insights and bi-monthly reports to inform continuous improvement.
* Manage digital marketing budgets to ensure cost efficiency and maximum ROI.

***Content and communications:***

* Source, brief and collaborate with influencers and content creators to produce trend-forward, campaign-aligned, and results-driven content.
* Safeguard and manage the company’s online reputation and brand integrity.
* Foster strong communication between digital teams and Signature Boutique stores to ensure continuous alignment.
* Coordinate workflow for ZA briefs with Le Creuset Content Studio.
* Oversee content production and logistics, this includes photo and video shoots – both in studio or on location.
* Stay ahead of social media trends to maintain relevance and engagement.

***Team management:***

* Utilise Asana for effective task and project management within the team.
* Provide leadership and general people management in consultation with the Marketing Director.

**The Perfect Blend: Your ingredients for Success**

* Formal qualification in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Digital Marketing Manager or in a similar role.
* A demonstrated knowledge of the branded consumer goods marketplace and experience with content production supporting premium lifestyle brands.
* In-depth knowledge of various digital marketing channels such as SEO, SEM, social media, email marketing, and performance marketing.
* Familiarity with marketing automation tools and web analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Marketing Suite, Meta Ads, Dot Digital).
* Strong analytical skills to track and measure the effectiveness of digital campaigns.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Up to date with the latest digital marketing trends and best practices.

**Why Join Our Table?**

At Le Creuset, you will find your seat at our table, which is as colourful as our cookware and rich in history. Our table is grounded in our values: **Passion, Integrity, Excellence, Innovation and Teamwork.** Every talent will add flavor. Every idea brings colour. And every day is a chance to create something that lasts. With the passion you bring, you become part of a timeless legacy, one that brings people together around food, stories, and meaningful shared moments.

**Diversity & Inclusion Statement**

*We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, race, ethnic or national origin. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential.*

**Ready to Stir Things Up?**

Apply now and help us create exceptional experiences, one customer at a time.

jobs.description:
**Over Le Creuset**

Bij Le Creuset begint elk gerecht met een verhaal – en elk verhaal begint met mensen.

Sinds 1925 brengen we generaties samen rond de tafel en veranderen we alledaagse maaltijden in dierbare herinneringen. Onze erfenis is gebaseerd op kleur, vakmanschap en een diepe passie voor innovatie – gevormd door zowel onze iconische producten als door de mensen die ze tot leven brengen. We maken niet alleen kookgerei, we creëren momenten die een leven lang meegaan. Als je geïnspireerd bent door traditie, gedreven door creativiteit enklaar bent om de toekomst van de keuken vorm te geven, verwelkomen we je graag in ons verhaal.

Ben jij een echte foodie met een passie voor retail? Droom je ervan om mee te bouwen aan premium winkelbelevingen en heb je een zwak voor mooi drukwerk? Ben je een multitasker die niet terugdeinst voor een uitdaging? Dan hebben wij dé stageplek voor jou!

**Het recept voor succes:**

Le Creuset Benelux zoekt een enthousiaste stagiair(e) om ons marketingteam te versterken. Samen met onze lokale marketingspecialist werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling en uitvoering van multichannel marketingcampagnes, met een focus op offline retail en trade marketing. Je krijgt de kans om zelf projecten op te zetten, actief mee te werken en impact te maken!

**Wat staat er op je dagelijkse menu?**

* Meewerken aan het vertalen en toepassen van de retailstrategie op de lokale markt, zowel voor onze eigen Signature Boutiques als voor onze retailpartners.
* Ondersteunen bij het opzetten van lokale acties en initiatieven die zorgen voor een premium winkelervaring.
* Creëren, vertalen en aanpassen van point-of-sale materialen (zoals posters en flyers), inclusief het druk- en distributieproces.
* Meewerken aan PR-activiteiten, samenwerkingen, evenementen en lokale partnerships.
* Samenwerken met ons contentteam en ondersteuning bieden aan interne en externe kanalen met beeldmateriaal en marketingassets.
* Samenwerken met onze contentstudio en zorgen voor beeldmateriaal voor eigen kanalen en partners.

**Wat staat er op uw seizoensmenu:**

Naast bovenstaande taken zul je ook periodiek enkele van de volgende onderwerpen behandelen:

* Helpen bij beurzen, events, salesmeetings, vertalingen en productbeheer afhankelijk van de noden.

**De perfecte mix: jouw ingrediënten voor succes**

* Je volgt een opleiding in Marketing, Communicatie of Bedrijfskunde en hebt een sterke interesse in premium retail marketing.
* Je bent creatief, hebt oog voor detail en zit boordevol originele ideeën.
* Je schrijft vlot en foutloos, en vertaalt moeiteloos van Engels naar Nederlands en/of Frans.
* Je bent een teamspeler met sterke communicatieskills en een positieve, leergierige mindset.
* Je werkt gestructureerd en georganiseerd, en houdt het hoofd koel bij multitasking.
* Ervaring in een premium retailomgeving of met het bestellen van POS-materiaal via drukkerijen is een pluspunt.
* Je bent handig met Word, Excel en PowerPoint; kennis van Photoshop, InDesign en/of Canva is mooi meegenomen.
* Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands of Frans én Engels; kennis van de andere landstaal is een troef.

**Praktische info over je stage:**

* Je bent voltijds student gedurende de hele stageperiode.
* Je bent beschikbaar voor minimaal 4 maanden.
* Startmoment: januari/februari of september/oktober.
* Je werkt 4 dagen per week op kantoor in Antwerpen of Breda (thuiswerk bespreekbaar).

**Waarom aanschuiven aan onze tafel?**

Bij Le Creuset vind je je plek aan onze tafel, die net zo kleurrijk is als ons kookgerei en rijk aan geschiedenis. Onze tafel is gebaseerd op onze waarden: **passie, integriteit, uitmuntendheid, innovatie en teamwork.** Elk talent voegt smaak toe. Elk idee brengt kleur. En elke dag is een kans om iets te creëren dat blijft. Met de passie die u meebrengt, word je onderdeel van een tijdloos erfgoed, een erfgoed dat mensen samenbrengt rond eten, verhalen en betekenisvolle gedeelde momenten.

Je wordt deel van een klein, maar hecht team in ons kantoor Antwerpen, waaruit je ook onze collega’s voor onze Nederlandse entiteit mee ondersteunt. Je werkt mee aan uitdagende projecten in alle aspecten van het retail landschap.

**Verklaring inzake diversiteit en inclusive**

*We verwelkomen sollicitaties van alle gekwalificeerde kandidaten, ongeacht geslacht, leeftijd, handicap, seksuele geaardheid, religie of geloof, burgerlijke staat of geregistreerd partnerschap, ras, etnische afkomst of nationaliteit. We streven naar een inclusieve werkplek waar iedereen zich gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt en de kans krijgt om zijn of haar volledige potentieel te benutten.*

**Klaar om de boel op te schudden?**

Solliciteer nu en help ons om uitzonderlijke ervaringen te creëren, één klant tegelijk.

We overtreffen onszelf voortdurend en moedigen onze teamgenoten aan hetzelfde te doen.
